recommended_strategy: 1 request to https://www.emcod.com/products, regex class="product_link" href="/products/info?id=(\d+)&?">([^<]+) to build SKU->id (normalize by stripping " T24"). For each needed id GET /products/info?id=N (<=1 req/s) and take the href inside div.product_img (absolute: https://www.emcod.com + path). Many SKUs share one id/image (family). Ignore the other upload_files_object images on the page (electrical diagram img.pdf_logo3, installation PDF link).
notes: Image resolution varies (166x504 up to 1115x652, PNG). Images are not watermarked as far as observed. Site served fine with browser UA.
